products.name: Cloud Adoption Security Assessment — Commercial
products.short_description: Assess your cloud security readiness end to end — a Zero-Trust and CAF-aligned assessment of identity, endpoints, data, apps, and infrastructure.
products.description:
Assess your cloud security readiness end to end — a Zero-Trust and CAF-aligned assessment of identity, endpoints, data, apps, and infrastructure.

Adopting or scaling cloud without a security baseline invites breach and rework. This assessment reviews your Microsoft cloud estate against the Cloud Adoption Framework and Zero-Trust pillars — identity, endpoints, data, apps, infrastructure, and network — scores maturity, and delivers a prioritized roadmap of the gaps that matter most.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Zero-Trust + Cloud Adoption Framework-aligned maturity assessment
  • Coverage review across identity, endpoint, data, app, infra, network
  • Secure Score, Conditional Access, and Defender posture review
  • Risk-ranked findings and a phased remediation roadmap
  • Executive summary + technical findings (read-only assessment)

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A scored, Zero-Trust-aligned view of your cloud security maturity and a phased roadmap — the evidence to invest where risk is highest.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • CLDSEC-ConditionalAccess.ps1 — read-only Conditional Access coverage/gap review
    • CLDSEC-Discovery.ps1 — read-only whole-estate discovery across the six Zero-Trust pillars
    • CLDSEC-Report.ps1 — read-only roll-up of the discovery outputs into a scored, risk-ranked findings report
    • CLDSEC-SecureScore.ps1 — read-only pull of Microsoft Secure Score and control profiles
    • CLDSEC-Validate.ps1 — read-only pre-flight that proves the assessment can run and is least-privilege

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
